segments.text: What if Earth was completely empty inside?
Earth's crust is just 5 to 70 kilometers thick.
Now scoop out everything below it, all the way to the center.
You just deleted over 99% of Earth's mass.
Gravity collapses. A 70 kilogram person would weigh less than a soda can.
Jump, and you'd soar 80 meters high.
Fall through a crack, and you float, because inside a hollow shell, gravity cancels out everywhere.
But with gravity this weak, our air would leak away into space.
And without the hot iron core, there's no magnetic shield.
So that heavy, burning core under your feet? It's why you can breathe.
